Verify that user is able to successfully log initial blood pressure vitals (systolic 80, diastolic 120) with a historical date
Verify that the target setup dialog can be closed via the Cancel button, returning the card to its default action state
Verify that target input fields display correct placeholder values for 'Systolic' and 'Diastolic'
Verify validation error 'Diastolic cannot be blank' when attempting to save a negative systolic target without diastolic
Verify validation error 'Systolic cannot be blank' when attempting to save a negative diastolic target without systolic
Verify validation error blocks saving systolic target values exceeding 250
Verify validation error blocks saving diastolic target values exceeding 200
Verify successful configuration and display of valid targets (Systolic: 15, Diastolic: 5)
Verify successful editing and update of blood pressure targets to new valid values (Systolic: 5, Diastolic: 15)
Verify that target modifications are reverted to previous configurations when editing is cancelled
Verify target edit error when entering negative systolic value
Verify target edit error when entering systolic greater than 250
Verify target edit error when clearing systolic input field
Verify target edit error when clearing diastolic input field
Verify empty state message ('No data recorded yet') and Add New button are visible after clearing all vital logs
Verify that logging historical blood pressure logs translates empty states to active health card widgets
Verify that logging a current day reading adds the vital values successfully and logs them inside the history table
Verify that logging a previous day reading is recorded successfully without overriding a more recent today's reading

TestExerciseSection
Exercise Empty State: navigating to the health tab renders the empty state title 'No data recorded yet' and the 'Add New' button is visible
Exercise Logging: logging a historical exercise entry (50 steps) for the past year successfully saves the log and keeps today's total at 0 mins
Exercise Logging: logging today's exercise entry (998 steps) successfully registers the entry and displays it in the history log list
Exercise Logging: adding yesterday's exercise entry (100 steps) does not overwrite or remove today's existing log entry
Exercise History: verifying both today's and yesterday's exercise entries are displayed sequentially in the history details log
Exercise Validation: verifying an error message ('Steps cannot be blank') is displayed when trying to save a blank steps entry
Exercise Validation: verifying an error message ('Steps cannot be blank') is displayed when entering a negative steps value
Exercise Validation: verifying an error message ('Steps must be less than or equal to 100000') is displayed when entering steps greater than 100000
Other Activity: logging an other activity entry by minutes (1 min) successfully displays the logged duration in the history list
Other Activity Validation: verifying an error message ('Minutes cannot be blank') is displayed when trying to save a blank minutes entry
Other Activity Validation: verifying an error message ('Minutes cannot be blank') is displayed when entering a negative minutes value
Exercise History: verifying that a user can successfully edit an existing exercise log inline in the history table list
Other Activity validation: entering a decimal Minutes value (0.1) displays the error message 'Minutes must be greater than or equal to 1'
Exercise History: verifying that deleting all exercise entries in the history table successfully clears the log list
Exercise Target: verifying the 'Set Target' button is visible on the exercise widget when no target has been configured
Exercise Target: verifying the set target input field placeholder text is correctly displayed as 'Min'
Exercise Target: verifying that clicking cancel while setting target closes the input field and returns to the initial state
Exercise Target Validation: verifying an error message ('Minutes cannot be blank') is displayed when saving a blank target value
Exercise Target Validation: verifying an error message ('Minutes must be greater than or equal to 1') is displayed when entering a negative target value
Exercise Target Validation: verifying an error message ('Minutes must be less than or equal to 1440') is displayed when entering target greater than 1440
Exercise Target: verifying a user can successfully configure a valid target value (500 min) and it is displayed on the widget
Exercise Target Validation: verifying an error message ('Minutes cannot be blank') is displayed when clearing the target input during edit
Exercise Target: verifying a user can successfully edit an existing target to a new valid value (7 min)
Exercise Target: verifying that clicking cancel during target edit reverts the input field changes to the previously saved value (7 min)
Exercise Target Validation: verifying an error message ('Minutes must be greater than or equal to 1') is displayed when entering a negative value during edit
Exercise Target Validation: verifying an error message ('Minutes must be less than or equal to 1440') is displayed when entering value greater than 1440 during edit
Exercise Logging: logging an exercise entry with 0 minutes displays a validation error
Exercise Logging: logging an exercise entry with the minimum valid value (1 minute) is saved successfully
Exercise Logging: entering a decimal minutes value less than 1 (0.5) is rejected with a validation error
Exercise Logging: entering alphabetical characters in the Minutes field is rejected with a validation error
Exercise Logging: entering special characters in the Minutes field is rejected with a validation error
Exercise Logging: multiple exercise entries can be successfully added on the same day
Exercise History: exercise history log is sorted in reverse chronological order (latest entries first)
Exercise Dashboard: daily exercise total updates correctly after adding multiple entries
Exercise Dashboard: daily total recalculates correctly after deleting one exercise entry
Exercise Dashboard: daily total updates correctly after editing an existing exercise entry
Exercise Logging: adding an exercise entry for a future date is restricted
Exercise History: exercise history date/time is correctly displayed in localized timezone format
Exercise History: filtering by Week, Month, and Year correctly filters the logged history entries
Exercise Graph: graph view renders a chart when data exists
Exercise Input: verifying that Steps and Minutes fields are type number, support spinner increments/decrements and keyboard navigation
Exercise Target: entering 0 as target value displays validation error and is not saved
Exercise Other Activity: editing an 'Other Activity' entry successfully updates the minutes
Exercise Other Activity: deleting an 'Other Activity' entry successfully removes it from history
Exercise Other Activity: multiple 'Other Activity' entries can be successfully added on the same day
Exercise Other Activity: daily totals include all 'Other Activity' entries and calculate correctly
Exercise Logging: a success message is displayed after saving an Exercise entry
Exercise Graph: graph shows no chart canvas when no Exercise data exists
Exercise Graph: clicking the Close (X) button successfully closes the graph modal
Exercise Input: clicking spinner up arrow increments the Minutes value by 1
Exercise Input: clicking spinner down arrow decrements the Minutes value by 1
Exercise Input: spinner up arrow does not exceed 100000 for Steps maximum value
Exercise Input: spinner up arrow does not exceed 1440 for Minutes maximum value
